text:
Asha (Halo Inc): Hey team — onboarding hit lots of 429s when our embedder SDK starts. Happening in the first 5–8s after deploy. Logs attached.
Maria (CSM): Thanks Asha — can you paste the root error? 429s or 503s?
Asha (Halo Inc): It's 429s. Snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-rlimit: preflight
retry-after: 1
```
Liam (DevEx): Looks like a preflight stampede — how many concurrent init workers/threads are you spinning up? Any LB or sidecar?
Asha (Halo Inc): We spawn ~40 k8s init workers that all call preflight + ephemeral token per worker.
Kai (Infra): 40 concurrent preflights + ephemeral tokens = thundering herd against preflight/quota. Recommend splaying startup, add jitter/exponential backoff, or use a shared preflight token cached for the pod.
Liam (DevEx): Example splay/backoff:
```
await sleep(random(0, startup_window));
await retry(fnPreflight, {factor:1.5, maxDelay:2000});
```
Docs: https://redwood.example/docs/sdk/preflight-splay
Maria (CSM): We'll open a support ticket and note this for onboarding docs. @eng-oncall please watch account halo-inc rates.
engbot: Created ticket #12345 (onboard-halo-inc-ratelimit)
Alex (eng-oncall): I can bump their preflight quota x5 for 10m to let the warmup finish, then revert. I'll monitor token-usage graphs and trace IDs.
Asha (Halo Inc): Trying backoff + a single shared token now, will report in ~2m :crossed_fingers:
Asha (Halo Inc): Update — backoff + shared token dropped 429s to near zero. We're green. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Liam (DevEx): We'll add a short note to the SDK quickstart about preflight splaying and an example snippet.
Maria (CSM): Marking onboarding status: green. Follow-up: 1:1 next week to review rollout and any docs gaps.
